SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT team_long_name FROM Team JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id WHERE buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT CAST(SUM(buildUpPlayPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL) AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.player_fifa_api_id), 2) FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY l.id HAVING (CAST(SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id)) > (CAST(SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id))
SELECT SUM(Match.home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Poland' AND Match.season = '2010/2011'

SELECT player_name FROM (SELECT player_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) as rank FROM Player) sub WHERE rank = 1
